evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to the reviewed candidate mechanism catalogue, source prediction already published; not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Exact Ti3Hf/HfTi3 ordered-phase query found no primary exact superconducting phase. Closest identified literature concerns ordinary refractory solid-solution chemistry; current SG221 ordered source object is distinct from hcp/bcc disordered alloys. Worldwide novelty remains unproved.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The matched all-Ti role substitution improves source pairing strongly, while Ti3Zr is a mixed-sign lambda control with only 0.05 K Tc change. Thus role/chemistry and 23% original graph volume change must be retained together; not an isolated geometry or mass cause. Target SCF forces are zero. Finite cubic local minimum does not prove thermodynamic ordering.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.002 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.118 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Zr-to-Ti role replacement in cubic Ti3Hf/Zr3Hf framework. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Use existing same-prototype electronic/mode data to separate Ti/Hf role response from volume, then phase-ordering evidence. Favorable: direct paired gain persists on the exact ordered branch; adverse: disorder or another phase destroys the relevant active network; ambiguous: nominal count/shorter bonds alone.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
